name.value: Fitzpatrick Family Vineyards at Greata Ranch

description.value: Fitzpatrick Family Vineyards at Greata Ranch is a historic lakeside winery on Highway 97 between Peachland and Summerland, specializing in Traditional Method sparkling wines made from estate-grown grapes on a site that has grown fruit since 1901. The property features a wine shop patio with panoramic Okanagan Lake views and the 19 Bistro serving lunch. It sits on a quiet bench above the lake, making it a scenic mid-ride stop for cyclists touring the Okanagan Valley.
